bindings.mutation: mutation of an unresolved binding is rejected
bindings.shadowing: duplicate bindings in one scope are rejected
bindings.source_rule: the first plain assignment declares a local; the compiler materializes let or var

canonical_expansion.bindings: all assignments are emitted as let or var
canonical_expansion.production_lowering: Canonical Typed AST lowers directly without canonical text reparsing
canonical_expansion.sum_types: Option and Result lower deterministically to closed tagged sums
canonical_expansion.tasks: kind, effects, capabilities, errors, and ownership are explicit
canonical_expansion.types: all inferred local, parameter, return, and public types are explicit

diagnostics.source_projection: generated canonical lines map to concise module paths and source lines

grammar.declaration_order: module first; use declarations before all other declarations
grammar.public_boundary: exported declarations materialize complete inferred contracts

ownership.drops: owned locals are dropped on every exit
ownership.moves: owned values move into owning constructors

public_signature_policy.annotations: canonical public parameters and returns are explicit
public_signature_policy.lock: .merlo-interface.json must exactly match all public interfaces
public_signature_policy.revision: hash module, name, kind, parameters, return type, effects, and capabilities

syntax_version_change.process: change the version constant and freeze manifest in the same reviewed change

task_effects.cli_main: exactly one task main with one Path parameter
task_effects.closure: private call-graph effects converge to a fixed point
task_effects.declaration: direct host calls introduce effects and capabilities
task_effects.pure_functions: an empty inferred effect row becomes fn
task_effects.read_visibility: public locks materialize every inferred authority change

type_inference.ambiguity: reject and request one constraining boundary annotation
type_inference.public_signatures: inference may use internal call sites, but every inferred public parameter and return type is materialized in canonical source
type_inference.recursive_groups: require at least one annotated parameter or return boundary
